card.name: Modifier words before a noun
card.fires_on: Adjectives or modifiers that sit right before a noun and describe its type or manner, such as portable, intermittent, hand, push and univariate. They appear in equipment, IV administration and statistics wording.

modes.description: Words like intermittent or push that describe how an IV dose is given.

modes.label: Other type modifiers
modes.description: Words that start a compound description, such as hand before cranked or Univariate before odds ratios.

card.writes: It seems to promote suffixes like -style and -stage, which fits a modifier that labels a type or manner.
card.plain: It marks a describing word that tells the type or manner of the next noun, like portable equipment or intermittent injection.
